---
description: Documentation, policy, governance, and agent-instruction safeguards.
applyTo: 'docs/**,policies/**,AGENTS.md,CLAUDE.md,.github/**/*.md,.github/instructions/**'
---

Read `docs/methodology/CONSTITUTION.md` first.

- Keep one canonical policy source and update all affected references in the same change.
- Every hard-constraint amendment needs a demonstrated risk, enforcement, evaluation scenario, and human approval.
- Do not silently weaken merge-blocking policy or represent proposed checks as executed.
- Validate Markdown links, rule IDs, policy references, and methodology consistency.
- Use exact rule IDs and affected locations when recording review findings.
